steps.content: With the song's finale, the bard bows gracefully to everyone. They acknowledge her, then, as if forgetting you ever existed, slip back into their respective "roles."
The bard's song isn't harsh to the ears, but it leaves you puzzled—the words sung clash with the present narrative! The character in the song... it's Lady Pearl!
You quickly emerge from behind the jumble of items and intercept the departing bard.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Excuse me, could you hold on a second? I need to ask you something!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: What?! Wh-wh-what?

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: What do you think you're doing?!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Better be careful—if I blow into this sax, I'll have a whole van of toughs here to sort you out in no time!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sorry about that, I didn't mean to come off strong. I just have some questions for you.
You nod with a hint of regret and release your hold.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Guess I got a bit carried away.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: My friends have vanished, and I'm really worried... This theater, it's eerie, like it's hiding something sinister.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've got to get to the bottom of what's really going on here, in this play... Your music, it tells a different story than what's unfolded here. I'm sure it's got the clues I need.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: You think my songs hold clues? Well, of course! They're songs of historical tales, after all! Wouldn't be surprised if they did have some hints!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Feel free to fire away with your questions! As a bearer of stories and a witness to history, I've got lots to share!
Tucked in a corner piled with odds and ends, the bard with a bird's nest hairdo, legs crossed, ready for your queries.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ever since I split from my crew, I figured we've all become characters in Fortuna's play.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: However, in this play, "Fortuna" refers to a prison, but in your lyrics...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's the name of a theater.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: So, can you tell me... are you a part of the script, or beyond it?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Maybe, your song is the script itself?
Echo, the bard, gazes at you with a furrowed brow, making you feel oddly uneasy.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: I'm not sure I get this whole "script" thing you're talking about. Are you... into my songs or something?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Sure, let's go with that. I want to know, is there more to your songs? What comes next?

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Ah, you're curious about the tales in my songs, huh? Those are stories I've gathered from all over, trading tale for tale!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: If you're eager to hear them, then it's only fair you swap some of your stories for mine!
Echo fishes out a bunch of papers from her bag and flicks them in your direction.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stories, you say? Well, I've got stories galore. What kind would you like to hear?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: A tale of a toy factory
A story of a game world

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Aww... Sob...

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: I'd love to give that little bear a cuddle as well.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Whoa, a place that amazing? I've got to see it for myself!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Really? I can come with you? You're not pulling my leg, are you?

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Zzzz...

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: What?! No, no, I wasn't snoozing! Wide awake here!

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Well, you've told quite a bit, but honestly, not many were all that intriguing...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: My friends are everything to me; I can't stress how much I need your clue.
You move forward, a bit impatient. The sax-cradling girl quivers slightly and puckers her lips.

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: Okay, okay, I'm not unkind or anything...

steps.speaker: Echo
steps.content: I don't get why you're so rushed, but since you seem to have a flair for music and really enjoy my songs, I'll make an exception and sing for you!
